crossRefs.note: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

translations.web: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to Yahweh.’
translations.bsb: “You are slackers!” Pharaoh replied. “Slackers! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
translations.kjv: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD.
translations.asv: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and sacrifice to Jehovah.
